Open WebUI plugin for model management

objectives.title: Open-Source AYU.OS Design System with Plugin Architecture

Primitive SVG library (15+ components) with validation
Composition engine for feature SVGs from primitives
Theme system (dark/light/custom) with CSS custom properties
React/Vue/Svelte wrapper packages
Storybook documentation + playground
NPM publish + GitHub Actions release automation
